title: What happens when a GPU fails?

scenes.heading: One worker reports a GPU fault
voice: A worker reports a GPU fault.
The operator needs to know what happens next.

scenes.heading: See what monitoring did
voice: The stock AICR configuration uses NVSentinel for monitoring.
It surfaces the health event so the operator can see the affected node and decide what to do.

scenes.heading: Enable an explicit quarantine policy
scenes.sub: Select the mixin for qualifying faults
scenes.result: New pods stay off that node
voice: For teams that want automatic quarantine, add the quarantine mixin to the recipe catalog and deploy the updated bundle.
On qualifying fatal faults, the configured controllers cordon and drain the node.

scenes.heading: Choose how hardware gets repaired
scenes.sub: Make automatic remediation a policy choice
voice: Quarantine leaves the node isolated for investigation.
Teams that want a configured action such as a reboot can choose the remediation mixin and its recovery policy.

viewer: GPU cluster operator selecting a fault response
payoff: Follow an NVSentinel event from stock monitoring to an explicitly configured quarantine policy for qualifying faults.
